config.gt_policy: exact GT identities, boxes, canonical classes and area/ignore/crowd metadata
config.input_policy: exact per-image tensor bytes, shape, dtype and preprocessing metadata

baseline.adapter_scope: Explicit experiment plugin; not the unmodified upstream wheel adapter
baseline.attention_semantics: deformable cross-attention only; weights and locations reconstructed from native projection outputs
baseline.diagnostic_prediction_space: decoder query slots before detection postprocessing
baseline.measurement: early eval scores use trained auxiliary heads; only executed layers are recorded
baseline.query_count_semantics: up to num_queries, bounded by available encoder tokens on newer upstream versions
baseline.query_identity: image-local decoder slots; encoder token ids are separate

candidate.adapter_scope: Explicit experiment plugin; not the unmodified upstream wheel adapter
candidate.attention_semantics: deformable cross-attention only; weights and locations reconstructed from native projection outputs
candidate.diagnostic_prediction_space: decoder query slots before detection postprocessing
candidate.measurement: early eval scores use trained auxiliary heads; only executed layers are recorded
candidate.query_count_semantics: up to num_queries, bounded by available encoder tokens on newer upstream versions
candidate.query_identity: image-local decoder slots; encoder token ids are separate

official_prediction_binding.detail: Annotation/protocol, image scope and raw GT identities are checked. Prediction-to-recorded-model binding is not verified; official Lost/Gained describe the supplied result pair, not proven outputs of the recorded models.

semantics.causality: Observations do not establish mechanisms or retraining benefits
semantics.correct_argmax: Highest-IoU valid normal query whose argmax class equals the GT class; no confidence gate
semantics.coverage: GT has a qualifying candidate with IoU>=0.50 or >=0.75; not official recall/AP
semantics.delta: Candidate minus baseline; null when either selected candidate is unavailable
semantics.density: Eligible GTs per image: sparse <=10, moderate 11..50, crowded >50
semantics.diagnostic_states: At IoU>=0.50, no confidence gate: no_valid_candidate; insufficient_geometry (no geometrically qualifying query); class_confusion (geometry covered, no correct-argmax query covers GT); correct_class_coverage. These are not TP/FN labels
semantics.excluded: Ignored/crowd/invalid GTs retained in rows but excluded from metric denominators
semantics.geometry: Highest-IoU valid normal query regardless of predicted class; no confidence gate
semantics.margin: p(GT)-max(p(other foreground classes)); single-class competitor=0; probability calibration may differ across models
semantics.official: Lost/Gained only from supplied CocoEvaluator annotation/protocol-identical matches
semantics.pairing: Same image and GT identity/metadata only; query ids are model-local and never paired across models
semantics.responsibility: Shared diagnostic Hungarian assignment with cost=(1-IoU)+0.25*(1-pGT), no confidence/IoU gate; not TP/FP
semantics.size: Original-pixel area: small [0,1024), medium [1024,9216), large [9216,infinity); diagnostic strata
semantics.stage: Final executed native decoder stage; decoder depths may differ
